ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 1) The Jacobean Period belongs to -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Jacobean Period belongs to ‘The Renaissance Period’.
The Renaissance Period (1500-1660) is divided into 4 main Periods. Such as-
-Elizabethan Period (1558-1603),
-Jacobean Period (1603-1625),
-Caroline Period (1625-1649) and
-Commonwealth Period (1649-1660).
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 2) Who introduced ‘Blank Verse’ in English Drama?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Henry Howard introduced blank verse into England in the 16th century with his translation of Virgil's Aeneid. Christopher Marlowe and William Shakespeare transformed it into the characteristic medium of Elizabethan and Jacobean drama.

Christopher Marlowe is the Father of English Drama/Tragedy.
-Elizabethan poet and Shakespeare's most important predecessor in English drama.
-He is noted especially for his establishment of the dramatic ‘Blank Verse’.
-He is a famous University wit.
His famous works:
-Doctor Faustus,
-The Jew of Malta,
-Tamburlaine the Great,
-Edward II,
-Didu, Queen of Carthage etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 3) The Modern Period of English Literature refers to -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Modern Period (1901-1939):
The period between 1901 and 1939 is generally accepted as the ‘Modern Period’ of English literature.
Queen Victoria's death in 1901 marks the beginning of this new literary era and the beginning of the Second World War in 1939 indicates its end.
The Modern Period comprises two shorter ages-
(a) The Edwardian Period (1901-1910)
(b) The Georgian Period (1911-1936)
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 4) Which one of the following is the first long poem in English Literature?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Beowulf is the first English long poem and the earliest European vernacular epic.
-The Author of Beowulf is Anonymous.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 5) ‘The Canterbury Tales’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Geoffrey Chaucer is considered one of the first great English poets.
He is the author of such works as The Parlement of Foules, Troilus and Criseyde, and The Canterbury Tales.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 6) Who is regarded as the Father of English Prose?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Wycliffe (1324 - 1384):
-He is called the father of English prose.
-He Translated Bible / New Testament into English from Latin.
Alfred the Great is being called the founder of English prose.
Francis Bacon is the Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 7) Which one is the first tragedy in English Literature?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Tragedy of Gorboduc is the first English tragedy written by Thomas Norton and Thomas Sackville.
-Its subject Gorboduc, a mythical king of ancient Britain.
-It is the earliest English tragic play in blank verse.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 8) ‘The Divine Comedy’ is a/an -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Dante Alighieri (1265-1321):
-Father of Italian Language or The Supreme Poet of Italy.
-He wrote the monumental epic 'The Divine Comedy. It is usually held to be one of the world's great works of literature.
-The Divine Comedy Divided into three major sections--Inferno. Purgatorio, and Paradiso.
-His famous poem is Inferno. It is the first part of The Divine Comedy.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 9) ‘The Jew of Malta’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Christopher Marlowe (1564 - 93):
He is the Father of English Drama/Tragedy.
-Elizabethan poet and Shakespeare's most important predecessor in English drama.
-He is noted especially for his establishment of the dramatic ‘Blank Verse’.
-He is a famous University wit.
His famous works:
-Doctor Faustus,
-The Jew of Malta,
-Tamburlaine the Great,
-Edward II,
-Didu, Queen of Carthage etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 10) ‘Amoretti’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Edmund Spenser (1552-99):
-Edmund Spenser is called the poet of poets.
-His famous sonnet collection is Amoretti.
His notable works:
-The Faerie Queene (Epic),
-The Shepherds Calendar,
-The Ruins of Time.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 11) Who wrote ‘Ralph Roister Doister’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Nicholas Udall (1505-1556): English playwright, translator, and schoolmaster.
- He is a writer from Elizabethan age.
- He wrote 'Ralph Roister Doister (1553)' which is the first English Comedy.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 12) Who is the father of English sonnet?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Sir Thomas Wyatt(1503-1542):
-The father of the English sonnet.
-He introduced the Italian sonnet and terza rima verse form and the French rondeau into English literature.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 13) Which literary work is by Ben Jonson?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Ben Jonson (1572-1637):
English Stuart dramatist, lyric poet, and literary critic.
Volpone (1605) is a famous play written by Ben Jonson. Its important character are Volpone, Mosca, Celia, Bonario, Corvino.
His other major plays are-
-Every Man in His Humour (1598),
-The Silent Woman (1609),
-The Alchemist (1610),
-Bartholomew Fair (1614).
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 14) “Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed and some few to be chewed and digested.” - this quote is by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
“Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed and some few to be chewed and digested.” - this quote is taken from - Essays of Studies by Francis Bacon.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 15) William shakespeare is called -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist and National poet of England.
-He was born on 23 April, 1564 AD and died on 23 April, 1616 AD.
-His Birthplace is Stratford Avon. He is often called the bard of Avon. (not ‘bird’)
-The Shakespearean period belongs to 1590-1616.
-He wrote 37 plays and 154 sonnets.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica and An ABC of English Literature, Dr, M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 16) Hamlet was a king of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Hamlet is a five-act tragedy written by William Shakespeare. In this tragedy ‘Hamlet’ was a king of Denmark.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 17) “Cowards die many times before their death.” - this quotation is from -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
“Cowards die many times before their death(Uttered by Caesar).” - this quotation is from Julius Caesar, William Shakespeare.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 18) Swan Song of Shakespeare is -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
A swan song is a final composition or performance, given before dying or retirement.
'The Tempest' is known as Shakespeare's Swan Song (Last work).
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr, M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 19) ‘Orlando’ is a character of the play -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option4: ঘ) The Taming of the Shrew
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
'As You Like It' is a famous comedy by William Shakespeare.
Important characters of 'As You Like It':
-Oliver,
-Orlando,
-Rosalind etc.
Source:Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 20) Who wrote the poem ‘The Sun Rising’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Donne is the father of metaphysical poetry.
-He is called the Poet of Love.
His famous poems are-
-The Good Morrow,
-The Sun Rising,
-The Canonization,
-For Whom The Bell Tolls etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 21) ‘To Daffodils’ is a famous poem by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Greatest Cavalier poet is Robert Herrick.
-He is a famous poet of the Caroline Period.
His famous poems are-
-To Daffodils,
-Delight in Disorder,
-The Night Piece of Julia,
-The Slitany to the Holy Spirit.

-‘The Daffodils’ was a famous poem written by William Wordsworth.
-‘Daffodils’ was a famous poem written by Ted Hughes.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 22) Which one is not written by John Milton -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Milton is called Epic Poet. He is also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'.
- His famous epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
- 'Lycidas' is a famous Elegy written by John Milton.

- Hudibras is an English mock-heroic narrative poem by Samuel Butler.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 23) The literary work ‘All for Love’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Dryden is the father of Modern English Criticism.
Famous works of John Dryden:
-All for Love,
-The Mistaken Husband,
-Absalom and Achitophel,
-Mac Flecknoe etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 24) ‘Comedy of Manners’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
‘Comedy of Manners’ was written by William Congreve.
-He is a writer from The Restoration Period.

His other notable works are:
-The Double Dealer,
-Love for Love,
-The Way of The World,
-The Old Bachelor etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 25) “An honest man is the noblest work of God.” Who said this?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Alexander Pope is a Mock Heroic Poet.
His famous quotation are-
- 'Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.'
- 'An honest man is the noblest work of God.'
- 'To err is human, to forgive is divine.'
- 'A little learning is a dangerous thing.'
Source: An Essay on Criticism by Alexander Pope.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 26) ‘The Rape of the Lock’ is a famous epic by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Alexander Pope is the poet of Augustan Period.
-His famous epic is 'The Rape of the Lock'.

The important character of this Epic:
-Baron (Hero),
-Belinda (Heroine),
-Arial (God).
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica and The Rape of the Lock.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 27) Which of the following novels is written by Jonathan Swift?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) A Tale of a Tub
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Jonathan Swift is the greatest satirist of the 18th century.
His famous novels are-
-Gulliver's Travels,
-The Battle of Books,
-A tale of a Tub,
-A Modest Proposal,
-A Journey to Stella.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 28) ‘Robinson Crusoe’ is a/an -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Daniel Defoe (1659 - 1761):
-He was an English novelist, pamphleteer, and journalist.
-His famous novels are- Robinson Crusoe, Captain Singleton.
-Characters of Robinson Crusoe are: Robinson Crusoe, Friday, Xury.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 29) The literary criticism ‘Preface to Shakespeare’ was written by-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Dr. Samuel Johnson is a writer from The Age of Sensibility (1745-1798).
Dr. Samuel Johnson works:
- Dictionary (1755),
- The History of Rasselas,
- Prince of Abyssinia (1759),
- Preface to Shakespeare (1765).
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 30) Thomas Gray is well known for his -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Thomas Gray was an English poet. Mostly Famous for his Elegies.
Famous works:
-Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard (1751),
-Alexander's Feast,
-Ode to Adversity,
-The Bard.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 31) Who wrote the poem ‘The solitary Reaper’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Wordsworth (1770 - 1850):
William Wordsworth is the pioneer of the Romantic Age.
-He is called Poet of Nature, Poet of Childhood, Lake poet.
His famous poems are-
-The Daffodils,
-Poems in Two Volumes,
-Lyrical Ballad,
-The Excursion,
-The Prelude,
-Lucy Poem,
-Tintern Abbey,
-The Solitary Reaper,
-Ode to Duty,
-My Heart Leaps Up etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 32) “Nature never did betray the heart that loved her.” this is a quotation by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
‘Nature never did betray the heart that loved her.’ - is taken from William Wordsworth's poem 'Tintern Abbey'.
Other famous quotes of Wordsworth:
- ‘Come forth into the light of things, let nature be your teacher.’
- ‘The child is the father of the man.’
- ‘Poetry is a spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings.’
-‘Poet is the breath and final speed of knowledge.’

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 33) Who is the author of the book ‘Biographia Literaria’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Samuel Taylor Coleridge (1772 - 1834):
Samuel Taylor Coleridge is an English Poet, critic and philosopher.
- He was a collaborator of William Wordsworth in the publication of the Lyrical Ballads.
- He is also remembered for his literary critique 'Biographia Literaria'.
Major works:
The Rime of Ancient Mariner (1798),
Kubla Khan,
Christabel,
Ode on Dejection.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 34) ‘The Rime of the Ancient Mariner’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Samuel Taylor Coleridge is an English Poet, critic and philosopher.
-He contributed a lot to the Romantic Movement in English Literature.
-He was addicted to opium.
-He was a collaborator of William Wordsworth in the publication of the Lyrical Ballads.
-He is mostly known for his brilliant poem 'The Rime of the Ancient Mariner'.
-He is also remembered for his literary critique 'Biographia Literaria'.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 35) Who wrote ‘Adonais’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Percy Bysshe Shelley (1792-1822):
-English Romantic poet.
-He believed that only revolution can change our society. So that he is called ''Revolutionary Poet''.
-He is also called ''The poet of Hope and Regeneration.''
-Shelly mourns over the death of John Keats in his famous elegy “Adonais''.
Famous Books:
Prometheus Unbound (1820),
A Defense of poetry (1820),
The Revolt of Islam.

Famous poems:
Ozymandias(1818),
Ode to the West Wind,
To a skylark,
Alastor,
Queen Mab,
The cloud.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica and An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 36) The poem ‘Isabella’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Keats (1795 - 1821):
John Keats was a writer from the Romantic period.
- He belonged to the Nineteenth century.
- He is called the Poet of beauty.
His notable works are:
- Isabella
- Endymion (1818),
- Hyperion (1820),
- Ode to a Nightingale,
- Ode to Autumn,
- Odes and Other Poems,
- Letters.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman & Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 37) Who was both a poet and a painter?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Blake (1757 - 1827):
William Blake was both a poet and a painter.
Famous books of Blake:
-The Marriage of Hell and Heaven,
-Songs of Innocence,
-Songs of Experience etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 38) ‘Childe Harold’s Pilgrimage’ is a -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
‘Childe Harold's Pilgrimage’ is an autobiographical poem in four cantos by Lord Byron.
Lord Byron's other Literary works are-
-Don Juan,
-She Walks in Beauty,
-The Corsair,
-Hours of Idleness (Collection of Byron's poem) etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 39) Who wrote ‘sense and sensibility’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Jane Austen is called an anti-romantic novelist in the romantic age.
Her famous novels:
-Pride and Prejudice,
-Sense and Sensibility,
-Mansfield Park,
-Emma,
-Persuasion etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 40) Ballad is -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option1: ক) A kind of short narrative poem
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) A kind of short consoling poem
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) A kind of short lyrical poem
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
A narrative poem that tells a story through dialogue and action is called ballad.
Ballad is mainly of two types:
1) The Folk, and
2) The Literary Ballad.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 41) Wordsworth was inspired by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Wordsworth (1770-1850) is the Romantic Poet.
-He was inspired by The French Revolution in 1789.
-He is known as Poet of Nature, Lake Poet, Poet of Childhood.
-He is believed in Pantheism.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 42) “Knowledge comes but wisdom lingers.” - Who said this?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Alfred Tennyson is a famous Victorian poet.
His famous quotations:
-'Knowledge comes but wisdom lingers.'
-'Sorrows are the best educator.'
-'The old order changeth, yielding place to new.'
-'Authority forgets a dying king.'
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 43) Who is the author of the book ‘Men and Women’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Robert Browning (1812-89):
-He is famous for his dramatic monologues.
Works:
- Dramatic Lyrics (1842)
- Men and Women (1855)
- Dramatis Personae (1864)
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 44) ‘David Copperfield’ is a novel written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Charles Dickens (1812-1870):
English novelist, generally considered the greatest of the Victorian era.
Famous novel of Charles Dickens:
-Oliver Twist,
-A Tale of Two Cities,
-Great Expectations,
-David Copperfield,
-The Christmas Carol,
-The Bleak House,
-The Battle of Life etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 45) Who wrote the novel ‘A Pair of Blue Eyes’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Thomas Hardy was a Pessimistic Novelist.
His famous novels are-
-A Pair of Blue Eyes,
-Tess of the d'Urbervilles,
-Far From the Madding Crowd,
-The Return of the Native,
-The Poor Man and the Lady,
-The Mayor of Casterbridge,
-Jude the Obscure,
-The Trumpet Major,
-Under the Greenwood Tree etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 46) Who is the author of the famous book ‘Sherlock Holmes’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Sherlock Holmes, fictional character created by the Scottish writer Arthur Conan Doyle.
-He is a British author and physician.
His other famous books:
-A Study in Secret,
The Sign of Four.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 47) The full name of E.M. Forster is -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
E.M. Forster (1879-1970):
-In full Edward Morgan Forster.
-British novelist, essayist, and social and literary critic.
-His fame rests largely on his novels Howards End (1910) and A Passage to India (1924).
Foster's other works:
-Aspects of Novel,
-Where Angels Fear to Tread,
-The Longest Journey,
-A Room With a View,
-The Celestial Omnibus(Collection of short stories).
source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 48) Who is a Victorian poet?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Robert Browning is a writer of The Victorian Period.
Thomas Gray, John Keats, S.T. Coleridge are writers of the Romantic Period.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr, M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 49) “Charity begins at home and justice begins next door.” This is a famous quotation by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Charles Dickens (1812-1870):
English novelist, generally considered the greatest of the Victorian era.
His famous quote -
‘Charity begins at home, and justice begins next door.’
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 50) ‘Winston Churchill’ got Nobel Prize in Literature in the year of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Winston Churchill, British statesman, orator, author and prime minister (1940-45, 1951-55).
-In 1953 Churchill was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature ''for his mastery of historical and biographical description as well as for brilliant oratory in defending exalted human values''.
Source: nobelprize.org.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 51) The ‘Poet Laureate’ is-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option1: ক) The best poet of the country
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) A winner of the Nobel Prize in poetry
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) The Court Poet of England
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The title of poet laureate was first granted in England in the 17th century for poetic excellence.
The poet was appointed as court poet of England who was given a post as an officer of the Royal Household.
-The first Poet Laureate was Ben Jonson in 1616.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica and Collins English Dictionary.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 52) Who is a Nobel Prize winner American woman novelist?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Pearl S. Buck is an American novelist and writer.
-She was awarded the Nobel prize in 1938 for her rich and truly epic description of peasant life in China. The name of the novel was 'The Good Earth'.
-Pearl S. Buck was the first American woman to win the Nobel prize for literature.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 53) Allen Ginsberg was a poet of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Allen Ginsberg was an American poet.
-His epic poem Howl (1956) is considered to be one of the most significant products of the Beat movement.
-September on Jessore Road is a poem by Allen Ginsberg on refugees from the Bangladesh Liberation war in 1971.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica and The New York Times.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 54) Who wrote the novels ‘The Old Man and the Sea’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Ernest Hemingway is an American novelist.
He was awarded the Nobel prize in 1954 for literature.
His famous novels are-
-For Whom The Bell Tolls,
-The Old Man and the Sea,
-A Farewell to Arms,
-The Sun Also Rises,
-Death in the Afternoon,
-To Have and Have not.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 55) Who wrote the play ‘Desire Under the Elms’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Eugene O’Neill (1888-1953):
American dramatist and winner of the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1936.
- ‘Desire Under the Elms’ is a play written by Eugene O'Neill.
His other plays-
-The Hairy Ape,
-Anna Christie (1922),
-Strange Interlude (1928),
-Ah! Wilderness (1933),
-The Iceman Cometh (1946),
-Long Day’s Journey into Night.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 56) Who wrote the play ‘Arms and the Man’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
George Bernard Shaw (1856-1950):
Irish comic dramatist, literary critic, and socialist propagandist, winner of the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1925.
Famous play of GB Shaw-
-Arms and the Man,
-Man and Superman,
-Doctor's Dilemma,
-Pygmalion etc.

The important characters of ‘Arms and the Man’ are:
Captain Bluntschli, Louka, Nicola, Raina Petkoff, Catherine Petkoff etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 57) Who wrote the short story ‘Heart of the West’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The real name of O'Henry is William Sidney Porter.
His famous works:
- Heart of the West,
- The Gift of the Magi,
- Sixes and Sevens,
- Roads of Destiny,
- Cabbage and Kings,
- The Four million,
- The Voice of the city etc.
Source: Encyclopedia britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 58) Who wrote the play ‘Death of a Salesman’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Arthur Miller is considered one of the greatest American playwrights of the 20th century.
-He is known for combining social awareness with a searching concern for his character's inner lives.
-He is best known for his play ‘Death of a Salesman (1949)’.
His other most popular plays are-
-All My Sons (1947),
-The Crucible (1953),
-A View from the Bridge (1955),
-The Misfits (1961) etc.
Source: Encyclopedia britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 59) ‘Murder in the Cathedral’ is a play written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
T. S. Elliot is an American Born British poet, dramatist and social critic.
-He is famous for his 'Theory of Objective correlative'.

His well known plays:
-Murder in the Cathedral,
-The Cocktail Party,
-The Trail of a Judge etc.

His notable works:
-The Waste Land (1922),
-Four Quartets,
-The Hollow Men,
-Ash Wednesday etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 60) Who wrote the novel ‘The Bluest Eye’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Toni Morrison was an American novelist, essayist, book editor and college professor.
-Her first novel, The Bluest Eye, was published in 1970.

His famous novels:
- Beloved,
- Song of Solomon,
- The Bluest Eye (got Nobel prize in 1993),
- Sula
- Home
- A Mercy etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 61) Who is not an American poet?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Butler Yeats (1865-1939):
- Irish poet, dramatist, and prose writer, one of the greatest English-language poets of the 20th century.
- He received the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1923.

Robert Frost, Emily Dickinson and Walt Whitman are three American poets.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 62) Who wrote the novel ‘Of Human Bondage’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Somerset Maugham is a English novelist, playwright and story writer.
His famous Novels are-
- Of Human Bondage,
- The Sacred Flames,
- The Razor's Edge,
- The Moon and Sixpence etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica and An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 63) The repetition of beginning consonant sound is known as -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Alliteration:
Repetition of a consonant at the beginning of two or more words or stressed syllables is called Alliteration.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 64) The climax of a plot is what happens -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Climax-the most intense, exciting, or important point of something, the culmination; peak, pinnacle; height.
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Climax is the peak of importance in a play or in a story. It is the point at which the rise of action ends and the fall of action begins.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 65) Metaphor is a comparison between -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Metaphor is an implicit comparison between two different things.
Example-
Time is money!
Life is but a walking shadow.
My life is local bus.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 66) A figure of speech in which apparently contradictory terms appear in conjunction -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Oxymoron:
A figure of speech in which apparently contradictory terms appear in conjunction.
When we use phrases like male-female, host-guest, civil war, open secret, magic realism or wise fool, we, in fact, use oxymorons.
Here is a famous example:
All changed, changed utterly:
A terrible beauty is born.
(Yeats: ''Easter 1916'')
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 67) Who wrote the novel ‘One Hundred Years of Solitude’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Gabriel Garcia Marquez was a Colombian novelist and one of the greatest writers of the 20th century.
-He was awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1982.
-His masterpiece work 'One Hundred Years of Solitude'.
His other notable works are:
- Love in the Time of Cholera,
- No One Writes to the Colonel,
- The Leaf Storm,
- Memories of My Melancholy Whores,
- News of a Kidnapping etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 68) ‘To His Coy Mistress’ is a poem written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Andrew Marvell is an English Metaphysical poet and politician.
His notable works are-
- To His Coy Mistress,
- The Definition of Love,
- The Garden etc.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 69) ‘Twelfth Night’ is a -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Notable comedy of William Shakespeare:
- Twelfth night,
- The Taming of the Shrew
- Two gentlemen of Verona,
- The Merchant of Venice,
- As you like it,
- All's well that ends well,
- A Midsummer Night Dreams,
- The tempest.
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 70) ‘The Picture of Dorian Gray’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Oscar Wilde was an Irish poet, novelist and dramatist.
His only novel-
The Picture of Dorian Gray (1891).

His comic masterpieces-
Lady Windermere’s Fan (1892) and
The Importance of Being Earnest (1895).
Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.
